verses.1: So, brothers, we ask you and urge you in the Lord Jesus to follow the ways that are pleasing to God. Let us hope that you will walk in those ways more often.
verses.2: For you know what requests we have given you through the Lord Jesus.
verses.3: For this is the will of God: that you be kept away from sexual immorality.
verses.4: Each of you should know that your own vessel is to be preserved in holiness and honor.
verses.5: Do not have desires during suffering, just as those nations who do not know the God also do not have such desires.
verses.6: It is not appropriate to overstep or exceed in this matter the limits set by his brother. After all, the Lord is the one who decides everything regarding these matters. This is what we have already said and also emphasize to you.
verses.7: For the Lord did not call us to impurity, but to holiness.
verses.8: The one who is detestable does not detest human beings at all; he detests only the God, and also the holy spirit that He gives to you.
verses.9: As for fraternity, there’s no need for you to write about it. After all, you yourselves are already commanded by God to love one another.
verses.10: And indeed, let us do this for all the brothers in all of Macedonia. We ask you, brothers, to do more than that.
verses.11: And they should also take pleasure in being quiet and peaceful, and to do what is right with your hands, as we have instructed you.
verses.12: So that you can move around comfortably towards those outside, and have no need for anything else.
verses.13: We do not want to ignore you, brothers, regarding those who are asleep. This is so that you will not be saddened, just as those who have no hope also are not saddened.
verses.14: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose from the dead, then God also justifies those who sleep through Him.
verses.15: This is what we are told by our Lord: that we, who are living beings who are destined to be present before His presence, should not waste our time on those who are asleep.
verses.16: For He, the Lord, in His command, through the voice of the trumpet and the trumpet sound of God, will descend from heaven. And those who are dead in Christ will rise first.
verses.17: And then, we who are living beings, those who are left behind, would be taken away in clouds, to the presence of the Lord in heaven. And in that way, we would always be with the Lord.
verses.18: So, please encourage each other in these discussions.
